The low-resolution specimen establishes no finish, and no same-work equivalence to the Japanese DP1 product is asserted. Reviewed 2026-08-20.

prints.name: Snorlax de Paul
prints.catchUpOf: the legacy WEST Spanish SVP 184 work; equivalence is not admitted here
prints.distribution: European Spanish, established by the official es-es asset and the printed ES modifier
prints.evidence: The official European-Spanish promo asset is retained as SPEC-0034. It reads the complete printed code "SVP ES 184", carries the "Juntos de Aventuras" stamp, and uses "Presión Dinámica". The publisher's LATAM counterpart SPEC-0033 instead reads "SVP LA 184", carries "Aventuras Compartidas", and uses "Plancha Dinámica". The full printed modifier remains part of the local set code. Retrieved 2026-08-11.
